description: Find Reddit conversations about a company, its competitors, a product category, or a topic, read from public Reddit feeds. mode company: give company_domain (for example smartlead.ai) and get thread and comment rows that name the brand or its competitors, each tagged complaint, praise, comparison, alternative_request, switching, buying_intent, feature_request, or question, with sentiment, a 0 to 100 intent score, and a displacement_signal when a competitor draws a complaint, switch, or alternative request, plus one company summary row with share of voice per competitor. mode category: give category_keywords (for example cold email tools) and get the companies discussed most, with mention counts and sentiment. mode gap: give subreddits and or a topic and get recurring questions grouped by theme, with unanswered counts and the tools the answers named. Tags are rule based. Blocked or empty results come back free with a row_status saying so. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per thread, comment, and summary row returned.

brand_names.description: Company mode. Names to search for, as the company writes them. Empty: resolved from the domain.

category_keywords.description: Category mode. Product lane phrases, for example cold email tools.

company_domain.description: Company mode. One company domain, for example smartlead.ai.

competitors.description: Company mode. Competitor names. Empty: found in the brand threads when discover_competitors is true.

discover_competitors.description: Company mode. Find competitors in the brand threads when none are given. Default true.

discover_subreddits.description: Gap mode. Find up to 8 subreddits from the topic when none are given. Default true.

domains.description: Company mode. Several domains, up to 50.

include_comments.description: Return comments as billed rows: comments that name the brand or a competitor (company mode), a company or keyword (category mode), or answers that name a tool (gap mode). Default true in company and gap modes, false in category mode.

include_hacker_news.description: Also search Hacker News. Default false.

known_companies.description: Category and gap modes. Names to always count.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_comment_threads.description: Threads opened to read comments, highest intent first. Default 20, 30 in category mode, 50 in gap mode.

max_comments_per_thread.description: Comments read per opened thread. Default 25.

max_threads.description: Thread rows per input, up to 1000. Each thread row is billed. Default 100.

only_new.description: Skip rows an earlier run with the same state_key returned. Default false.

product_names.description: Company mode. Product names to search for beside the brand.

proxy_mode.description: auto uses the Apify datacenter proxy and moves to residential when Reddit refuses; residential uses residential only. A reliability choice; proxy use adds nothing to the price. Default auto.

since_days.description: Only threads from the last this many days. Default 90.

state_key.description: Names the seen list for only_new.

subreddits.description: Limit searches to these subreddits, without r/.

topic.description: Gap mode. What the questions are about.

topic_terms.description: Gap mode. More search phrases for the same need. Reddit returns only posts with every word of a query, so a two word topic can be narrow. Up to 10.

use_identity_resolver.description: Company mode, when brand_names is empty. true runs Mamba Labs Company Identity Resolver from your account, which Apify charges at its own result price (0.007 USD per domain); false uses the homepage title. Default true.

vendor_subreddits.description: A vendor's own subreddit (named after the brand, a competitor, or a company found in the run) is read as marketing. exclude (default) drops those threads; flag keeps them with vendor_subreddit true and out of every count; include keeps them with vendor_subreddit true and counts them. A subreddit named in subreddits is never treated as one.

webhook_top_n.description: Rows in the webhook, 1 to 50. Default 10.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL. One POST at the end with a Slack compatible text field and the top rows.
